config.name: critical_cone_directional_differentiation
config.constraint_class: Polyhedral Euclidean projection, including weakly active constraints
config.regular_point_backward: Use the certified face tangent projector.
config.degenerate_point_derivative: For input direction d, solve min_v 0.5*||v-d||^2 over the critical cone T_C(x) intersect (z-x)^perp.
config.reverse_mode_policy: Expose a documented adjacent-face generalized-Jacobian selection; do not label it a unique classical derivative.
config.factor_reuse: Reuse available face factors within critical-cone subproblems.
config.ablation: Compare with treating every tight inequality as an equality.
